content: Amɨn kɨnda Piŋkop da kɨlani asak do bɨsit agɨt
Kap on kap yoŋ dakon kɨla amɨn do mandabi. Dewit dakon kap kɨnda. Gita tɨdaŋek yogogɨ.

content.text: Piŋkop, mɨrakgo yopmaŋek aŋpulugoki do yaŋ tɨdosot uŋun nandaki.
Nak mɨktɨm dubagɨsikon da gak do yaŋ tɨdosot.
Butnokon da paŋpulugogɨ mɨni egɨsat yaŋ nandaŋek yaŋ tɨdosot.
Aŋkɨ nepbɨ tɨp madep da yoŋgamon pasɨlɨ egɨpbeŋ,
Nagal tebano agaki uwalno da arɨpmɨ dɨma abɨŋ nepni.
Nak bɨsap mudok mudogɨ mɨni gak da yutnon egɨpbeŋ do nandɨsat.
Pup pudɨk meŋi da pɨtgwan tagɨsi ekwaŋ, uŋun da tɨlak gak da kapmatjok egapbo aŋkutnoki do nandɨsat.
Piŋkop, nak yaŋ teban tok agɨm uŋun gak da nandagɨl.
Yo tagɨsi gak do pasolgoŋ amɨn kabɨ do yomɨsal uŋun nak do kɨlɨ namgul.
Kɨla amɨn madep aŋteban abɨ bɨlak morapmɨsi egɨpjak.
Aŋteban abɨ babɨkni morapmɨ altaŋ altaŋ ani uŋun pɨndatjak.
Piŋkop, aŋteban aŋaki bɨsap dagok dagogɨ mɨni gak da dabɨlon kɨla amɨn madep egɨpjak.
Toktogɨsi but dasi galak taŋ ɨmɨŋek kɨlani aŋek aŋkutnoki dosi nandɨsat.
Yaŋ aŋaki gɨldarɨ gɨldarɨ yo ak do yaŋ teban tok agɨm uŋun abeŋ.
Aŋek gɨldarɨ gɨldarɨ kap yaŋek mango aŋkɨsikeŋ.
